title_zh: 写出区分保释与判决的课堂摘要

scenario.label_zh: 区分课堂案件中的指控与保释
scenario.goal_zh: 根据虚构案件材料区分袭击指控与保释状态，并写出不预断有罪的摘要

context_zh: 学生与老师阅读自编法律新闻练习材料，不涉及真实案件或法律建议。
author: author-phase10-a

sentences.speaker: Tessa
sentences.text: The fictional report says the man was charged with assault and released on bail. Does that mean the court found him innocent?

sentences.speaker: Mr Reed
sentences.text: No. Look at the next line: the trial hasn't taken place. Bail tells you about his release while the case continues, not the verdict.

sentences.speaker: Tessa
sentences.text: So I shouldn't write that he committed the attack either?

sentences.speaker: Mr Reed
sentences.text: Correct. Report the charge as a charge, and keep it separate from any finding of guilt.

sentences.speaker: Tessa
sentences.text: I've written: 'The man faces an assault charge and has been released on bail ahead of his trial.'

sentences.speaker: Mr Reed
sentences.text: That accurately reflects the information in this exercise.
